title: When the House Burns
author: Freya Dravenmoor
blurb: Rosalind Quintana, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
